“Good morning. It’s Tuesday. We were up late being silly at Kirsten’s. Not really sure what’s in store for us today. Which is why it’s important to stay rested. Also, I love you.”

[Archival]
They’re going to sign the Ribbentrop-Ribbentrop pact.
Sleepover at Kirsten’s to minimize stress.
I finally convinced them the movers weren’t robbing the place.
“Good morning. It’s Monday. Thumb guy came home, which was great. But now they’re just moving our stuff out of the house. What is up with that? Also, I love you.”

Yes. I famously only said Tucker was full of crap until recent events. Nailed it.


🐾Philly Puppy🐾 (@liberalpuppy)

Amazing how Tucker wasn’t full of crap until he questioned the direction of the Republican Party…



— https://nitter.net/liberalpuppy/status/2050957298873352479#m

People exploiting this clearly f’d up family situation should be ashamed. 

Also, people who think Israel is throwing money at New Mexico state senators are morons.


James Tate (@JamesTate121)

BREAKING NEWS 🆘The daughter of U.S. Republican Senator Jay Block: 🆘

"Israel pays money to my father, and he spreads propaganda.   

I am deeply ashamed of this situation. I believe my father has sold his soul to the devil.   

I hope his career ends!"
